raw_storage_policy: Original binary and large files remain outside Git; exact filenames, byte sizes, and SHA-256 values are recorded here.

limitations: No Sejong time-resolved turning counts are included.
No current Sejong signal timing, phase sequence, TOD plan, or offset is included.

Cheonan and KICT data may shape reference ranges and adapters, not absolute Sejong calibration.
Jeju and Incheon data are external parser and UI fixtures only.
No BASE_DEMAND, capacity, storage, fairness, safety, or control threshold is changed.
